title: Extend date string parsing to handle "2018-03-03T11:22:48+01:00"
body:
While investigating #316 I noticed that the AndroidAPS.log had many entries of the form

```11:25:50.585 [IntentService[DataService]] ERROR [NSDeviceStatus.java:243]: Unhandled exception
java.text.ParseException: Unparseable date: "2018-03-03T11:22:48+01:00" (at offset 19)
        at java.text.DateFormat.parse(DateFormat.java:571) ~[na:0.0]
        at info.nightscout.utils.DateUtil.fromISODateString(DateUtil.java:51) ~[na:0.0]
        at info.nightscout.androidaps.plugins.NSClientInternal.data.NSDeviceStatus.updatePumpData(NSDeviceStatus.java:213) ~[na:0.0]
```

While I am (strangely, but I am not an Andriod developer) not able to find a ``NSDeviceStatus.java`` file in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip I see two ``DateUtil.java``, one in ``:app`` and the other in ``:wear``. If I was to create a Pull Request for thie, would those be the two files to change?
